title: Professional Ear Eater
body:
Has somehow survived countless hours of me yapping about absolutely everything and still picks up my calls every single day

A true warrior honestly

title: Professional Eye-Poke Specialist
body:
Has been threatening to poke my eyes the very first time we meet again for what feels like forever

I'm still living in fear

title: Future Cheek Munching Expert
body:
Currently only theoretical due to a very rude 2500 km between us

Scientific testing will commence as soon as possible

title: Supplier of Great Wall of China Grade Sugar Trucks
body:
Still can't believe you thought I'd reject your confession with the world's biggest sugar truck after disappearing for ten whole days

Turns out I was just busy falling even harder for you
